answers.q-routine-meals: Honestly on the steps outside the rec center a lot, with a sandwich. Dining hall for dinner with my roommate twice. I just can't sit under those lights after being in class all day.

answers.q-challenges-hard-part: Everything here happens inside. Meetings, mixers, study groups, all in rooms with no windows. I don't know how to meet people in a room.
answers.q-values-good-friend: Says yes to the early thing even though they're tired.

answers.q-joys-comfort: A run with no route and no watch.
answers.q-hopes-try: The outdoor club's overnight trip. I keep not signing up because I don't know anyone going.
answers.q-routine-first-hour: I'm up at 5:45 and out the door by 6! A loop along the creek while it's still gray, then a shower and oatmeal. It's the best hour of my day and I spend it with zero humans.
answers.q-routine-between: Outside on the rec center steps, or the grass by the creek bridge if it's dry. I eat, stretch, and stare at trees until I have to go back in.
answers.q-routine-sunday: Long trail day! I take the first shuttle out toward the ridge and I'm usually back by two. Then homework with the window open. I love it, I just wish I had someone to say "look at that" to.
answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: Monday! A girl in my geology lab tripped over the same root as me on the field walk, like five seconds apart, and we both just sat there laughing in the leaves.
answers.q-belonging-almost: My roommate invited me to a late movie in the lounge. I almost went, but it started at 10:30 and I had a sunrise planned. I kind of regret it, honestly.
answers.q-belonging-know-you: That I'm a completely different person outside. Louder, funnier, braver! In a classroom you're getting about half of me.
answers.q-interests-hours: Trails! Which ones are worth the climb, where the water is, what's blooming. Please ask me.
answers.q-interests-making: I'm training for a trail half marathon in the spring. Hill repeats on the one hill we have!
answers.q-values-respect: They pick up a piece of trash that isn't theirs without making a show of it.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I used to think going alone made me independent. Now I think it mostly means I never asked anybody.
answers.q-values-time: Being outside for no reason! Not exercise, not a photo, just standing in it.
answers.q-hopes-different: I'd love one standing morning a week with a trail buddy. Same day, same time, no group chat required.
answers.q-joys-song: The creek, honestly. I run without headphones. But there's one fiddle tune I play while I pack my bag the night before.
answers.q-joys-place: The muddy path behind the baseball field. Everyone avoids it, but it goes to a little clearing with a fallen log and I've never seen another person there.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Sitting still! Three-hour labs with no windows are so much harder than I expected.
answers.q-challenges-easier: Company for early things. "Want to get up at 5:30 with me?" is a hard sell and I know it.
answers.q-hopes-learn: Somebody in the outdoor group knows every plant by name. I want to follow them around with a notebook.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The first real cold morning, when the grass crunches! And I think I'm finally signing up for the overnight.
answers.q-challenges-habit: I'm trying to actually ask one specific person instead of posting in a group chat. I did it once and she said maybe next time, which isn't a no!
answers.q-joys-treat: Hot apple cider in my camp mug, out on the front steps.

answers.q-routine-meals: I take my food outside whenever it isn't raining. There's a low wall by the garden plots. Usually it's just me, sometimes a grounds worker on break.
answers.q-belonging-pretend: I told my friends the windowless study room in the library basement was fine for our group. I lasted forty minutes before I made up a reason to leave.

answers.q-interests-teach: How to identify five common birds by sound alone.
answers.q-hopes-weekend: A long slow morning walk with someone who doesn't mind stopping, then an afternoon digging in the garden.
answers.q-challenges-hard-part: I didn't expect to feel so enclosed. Dorm, hallway, lecture hall, dining hall. You can go a whole day without touching weather.
answers.q-values-good-friend: They ask if you want company before assuming you want to be alone.
answers.q-routine-late-night: Stretching, then journaling a little. Some nights I rehearse choreography in the hallway.

answers.q-belonging-home: The sky being bigger. I know that isn't physically true, but it was.
answers.q-joys-comfort: I walk until my head is quiet. It usually takes about two miles.
answers.q-hopes-try: Asking someone to come with me. I always assume nobody wants to be up that early, and I've never checked.
answers.q-routine-first-hour: I open the window first, whatever the weather, and stand there for a minute. Then tea, and a short walk past the garden plots before my first class.
answers.q-routine-between: The low wall by the garden. I watch what's visiting the feeder and write down anything new. If it rains I stand under the greenhouse awning instead.
answers.q-routine-sunday: Sundays are my garden mornings. I'm usually the first one there, and I leave when the others arrive, which I've started to think is a mistake.
answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: On Saturday, with one of the garden volunteers. A squirrel stole an entire seed packet from her pocket and she chased it halfway across the lawn.
answers.q-belonging-almost: A friend from dance asked me to a study night in the library basement. I nearly agreed, and then I pictured that room.
answers.q-belonging-know-you: That I'm not withdrawn, I'm just an outdoor person kept mostly indoors. Walk with me and I'm much easier to know.
answers.q-interests-hours: Why certain birds come back to the exact same tree every year. I find that endlessly moving.
answers.q-interests-making: I've been building a small bird feeder from scrap wood, and practicing a piece of choreography I'd love to perform outside one day.
answers.q-values-respect: They lower their voice near something wild rather than scaring it off.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I used to believe solitude outdoors was the purest way to be there. Lately I think a second pair of eyes would see things I miss.
answers.q-values-time: Walking without a destination. People here walk only to arrive.
answers.q-hopes-different: I would like at least one of my morning walks each week to include another person, and fewer afternoons under fluorescent lights.
answers.q-joys-song: The dawn chorus, truly. I recorded it on my phone in September and I play it when I study inside.
answers.q-joys-place: The compost corner of the garden. People hurry past it, but the soil there is warm and the robins know it.
answers.q-challenges-harder: How little daylight I get. My schedule runs from nine to five indoors, and by the time I'm free the sun is going.
answers.q-challenges-easier: An hour outside together. It sounds like such a small request, and still I hesitate.
answers.q-hopes-learn: One of the grounds workers knows every tree on campus. I'd like to learn their names from him.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The late migrants coming through. And the garden's fall planting day, when I intend to stay after the others arrive.
answers.q-challenges-habit: I'm trying to stop inventing excuses to leave rooms and simply say I need some air. It's going reasonably well.
answers.q-joys-treat: A pear, eaten slowly on the wall.

answers.q-belonging-pretend: People in my workshop kept referencing some first-year retreat they all went to. I laughed like I got it.
answers.q-joys-small-win: My professor wrote 'this line is doing a lot of work' next to a sentence I almost cut.
answers.q-interests-teach: How to read a poem out loud without doing the poetry voice.
answers.q-hopes-weekend: Saturday in the cafe near the bus stop with my draft, then I guess somebody saying 'come along' to literally anything.
answers.q-challenges-hard-part: Everybody's already got their people from first year. You're not unwelcome, there's just no open seat, if that makes sense.
answers.q-values-good-friend: Invites you again even after you said no the first time.
answers.q-routine-late-night: Just off the last bus, typing up whatever I scribbled on the ride.
answers.q-interests-rabbit-hole: Early drafts of famous novels. They were all bad at first, very comforting.
answers.q-belonging-home: My old school's lit magazine. Six of us in a basement room arguing about commas. I knew where I fit.
answers.q-joys-comfort: long walk, one album start to finish
answers.q-hopes-try: Submitting something to the campus lit journal. And staying on campus past 6 for once.
answers.q-routine-first-hour: On the 7:10 bus with a notebook on my knee. I get about four usable lines before my stop, and my handwriting looks like a seismograph.
answers.q-routine-between: The bench outside humanities, or the hallway outside my workshop room if it's raining. I read and try to look like I'm waiting for someone.
answers.q-routine-sunday: Groceries, laundry, then I revise whatever my workshop tore apart. Campus feels very far away on Sundays, mostly because it is.
answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: After workshop last week. Somebody read my poem in the full poetry voice as a joke and I lost it, then showed them how to do it properly.
answers.q-belonging-almost: A reading at the cafe that started at 8. I looked up the last bus, did the math, and said maybe next time. I always say maybe next time.
answers.q-belonging-know-you: I showed up in the fall as a transfer, so I'm quieter than I actually am. I'm still figuring out where I'm allowed to sit.
answers.q-interests-hours: Line breaks. Why you end a line where you end it. I've bored at least three people with this already.
answers.q-interests-making: A long poem about the bus route, one section per stop. There are fourteen stops, which may have been a mistake.
answers.q-values-respect: Says "come sit with us" and then actually moves their bag.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I thought I'd transfer and just slot in. Turns out you have to keep showing up to the same thing for weeks first.
answers.q-values-time: Reading each other's stuff properly. Not skimming it five minutes before class.
answers.q-hopes-different: I'd like to have stayed on campus after dark at least twice, and to have one table that is sort of mine.
answers.q-joys-song: One folk album, front to back, on the ride home. The last track usually lands right at my stop.
answers.q-joys-place: The bus shelter by the humanities building, honestly. It has a roof and a view of the quad, and nobody asks why you're there.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Finding out about things. Everybody else seems to hear about readings and deadlines through people, and I find the flyer a day late.
answers.q-challenges-easier: "What is everyone doing after this?" It sounds so simple when other people say it.
answers.q-hopes-learn: How the lit journal actually gets put together. I'd like to be in the room where they argue about commas.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The journal's submission deadline, weirdly. And a workshop dinner that is early enough for me to catch the bus after.
answers.q-challenges-habit: Trying to stop leaving the minute class ends. I made it fifteen extra minutes on Tuesday.
answers.q-joys-treat: A hot chocolate from the cafe by the bus stop if I've got six minutes to spare.

answers.q-routine-meals: Kitchen of my off-campus apartment. My housemate's usually around, she's a transfer too, so we eat cereal and compare notes on what we've missed.
answers.q-belonging-pretend: Somebody asked if I was going to lantern night and I said probably. No clue what it is.
answers.q-joys-small-win: It got cold enough for a real coat and I didn't hate it.
answers.q-interests-teach: How to tell if an avocado is ready. People here are bad at this.
answers.q-hopes-weekend: A hike with the outdoors group, then calling my sister at an hour that works for both of us for once.
answers.q-challenges-hard-part: Transferring means you're new but nobody treats you as new. Orientation was for the first-years.
answers.q-values-good-friend: Texts 'home safe?' after.
answers.q-routine-late-night: It's only 8 back home, so that's when my phone finally wakes up. I'm half asleep answering everybody.
answers.q-interests-rabbit-hole: Tide charts, weirdly. I can't see the ocean from here so I look at the numbers.
answers.q-belonging-home: Fog in the morning that burns off by noon. And burritos. I've stopped explaining what a real one is.
answers.q-joys-comfort: Long shower, then lying on the floor.
answers.q-hopes-try: Showing up to a campus tradition and actually knowing what's going on.
answers.q-routine-first-hour: Coffee, then a look at the weather app for both coasts. It's three hours earlier back home, so nobody's awake to hear my complaints.
answers.q-routine-between: The outdoors club gear room if it's open. Otherwise the steps of the science building, where I eat an apple and watch people who know where they're going.
answers.q-routine-sunday: Long run, groceries, then a call home that I schedule like a meeting because of the time difference.
answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: Last night. My housemate and I listed every campus tradition we'd agreed to attend without knowing what it was. We're at five.
answers.q-belonging-almost: A bonfire thing the outdoors group mentioned. I nearly went, then realized I didn't know where "the usual spot" was and didn't want to ask.
answers.q-belonging-know-you: I grew up next to the ocean. Being this far inland makes me a little off, and that's most of what you're seeing.
answers.q-interests-hours: Coastlines. Tide pools, specifically. I'll stop when asked.
answers.q-interests-making: A trail map of everything within an hour of campus, with notes. Nobody gave me one, so I'm making it.
answers.q-values-respect: Answering a basic question without the "wait, you don't know?" face.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I assumed being a junior meant I'd skip the awkward part. You get the awkward part regardless of year.
answers.q-values-time: Being outside for no reason. People here walk fast and only to get somewhere.
answers.q-hopes-different: I'd like to recognize more faces on my walk across the quad. Four would be a strong start.
answers.q-joys-song: A recording of waves, honestly. I put it on when I'm falling asleep and pretend it's the real thing.
answers.q-joys-place: The roof level of the parking structure. You can see weather coming from an hour away.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Winter clothes. There's a whole system of layers and I learned it by being cold.
answers.q-challenges-easier: Context. "What is that, and why does everyone care?" gets old to ask.
answers.q-hopes-learn: How to dress for actual snow. Someone here grew up with it and I'd take notes.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The outdoors group's overnight trip. And flying home for break, where the fog is.
answers.q-challenges-habit: Trying to ask the question instead of nodding. It's going about fifty-fifty.
answers.q-joys-treat: Chips and guacamole I make myself, because I can't trust anyone else's here.

answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: Yesterday at dinner. A guy from my floor tried to say the name of my city and we laughed for five minutes. He was not close.

answers.q-belonging-know-you: I am more funny at home. Here the joke arrives in my head in the wrong language and by the time I translate it, the moment is gone.
answers.q-interests-hours: Bread. Why the bread here is soft like a pillow, and what can be done about it.
answers.q-interests-making: I am practicing my volleyball serve behind the gym, alone, so that I do not embarrass myself at tryouts.
answers.q-values-respect: When they ask how to say my name and then they remember it next time.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I thought eating dinner at 5:30 was a sad thing. Now I see it gives you a long evening. I still do not like it.
answers.q-values-time: Sitting at the table after the food is finished. Here people stand up as soon as the plate is empty.
answers.q-hopes-different: I would like to cook for people once a week, and to have a call time with home that does not need a calculator.
answers.q-joys-song: The radio station from my city, the morning program. I play it while I cook dinner, so they say good morning while I chop onion.
answers.q-joys-place: The international aisle of the grocery store near campus. It is one shelf, but I visit it like a museum.
answers.q-challenges-harder: The small talk. "How are you" is not a question here, and I answered it honestly for the whole first month.
answers.q-challenges-easier: To ask people to speak slower without them starting to speak louder.
answers.q-hopes-learn: The rules of American football. I have watched three games and I understand nothing.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: Intramural volleyball signup. Also a package from my mother, which has been "almost there" for two weeks.
answers.q-challenges-habit: I try to stop converting every hour into the time at home. It is not going well. Right now it is 4 in the morning there.
answers.q-joys-treat: A slice of bread with butter and paprika. It is simple and it is correct.

answers.q-routine-meals: Mostly the cafe by the library with a book, sometimes with one girl from my seminar. I miss a proper afternoon coffee break with something sweet. We have a word for it.
answers.q-belonging-pretend: That I find it charming when people ask if it's always dark where I'm from. It is dark in winter. That is the whole answer.
answers.q-joys-small-win: Frost on the quad this morning. Everyone complained and I felt like myself for the first time in weeks.

answers.q-hopes-weekend: A long walk somewhere with trees, then reading in the same room as someone without having to talk.
answers.q-challenges-hard-part: I am funnier in my own language. Here I am a slightly slower, more polite version of me.
answers.q-values-good-friend: Notices when you have gone quiet and doesn't make a scene of it.

answers.q-interests-rabbit-hole: I've been comparing two English translations of a book I grew up with. They disagree on nearly every page.
answers.q-belonging-home: The light in June, when it never fully gets dark. And silence that nobody feels a need to fix.
answers.q-joys-comfort: Candles, a blanket, a book.
answers.q-hopes-try: The book nook meetup. I'd like to hear what people here read as children.
answers.q-routine-first-hour: Coffee, properly made, and ten minutes at the window before I speak to anyone. Then I read the messages my family sent during their morning, which was my night.
answers.q-routine-between: The cafe by the library, at the small table near the radiator. I read, and now and then I write down an English idiom I overheard and do not yet trust.
answers.q-routine-sunday: I bake something in the morning, call my parents while it is still afternoon for them, and then read until the light goes, which here is disappointingly late for winter.
answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: On Thursday, with the girl from my seminar. I translated one of our proverbs word for word and it came out as a threat involving a cow. We could not stop.
answers.q-belonging-almost: A dinner for eight after seminar. I had the yes ready, and then I pictured three hours of being the slower version of myself and went home to my book.
answers.q-belonging-know-you: That my silences are comfortable ones. Where I come from, nobody takes a pause in conversation as a problem to solve.
answers.q-interests-hours: Translation, and what is lost in it. Give me one sentence in two versions and I am occupied for the evening.
answers.q-interests-making: I am translating a short children's story from home into English, badly, for my own amusement. The jokes do not survive the trip.
answers.q-values-respect: Asking a real question about where I am from and then listening to the whole answer.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I used to think American friendliness was insincere. I now think it is sincere but brief, which is a different thing.
answers.q-values-time: Coffee breaks that are actually breaks. Sitting down, something sweet, no laptop on the table.
answers.q-hopes-different: I would like a weekly afternoon coffee with the same one or two people, so that it becomes a habit and not an event.
answers.q-joys-song: A choir recording from home that we sing in midwinter. I play it when the afternoon gets dark, which is the one hour I do not feel far away.
answers.q-joys-place: The north path behind the greenhouse when it is cold. Everyone avoids it for the wind; I go there for the wind.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Being funny. I did not expect that to be the part of me that would not translate.
answers.q-challenges-easier: Company without conversation. "Come read in the same room as me" sounds odd in English.
answers.q-hopes-learn: What people here read as children. I would like someone to hand me the book that everyone seems to quote.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The first real snow, if it comes, and the book nook meetup, which I have now put in my calendar in ink.
answers.q-challenges-habit: I am trying to stop composing sentences in my head before I say them. It makes me a full beat late to every joke.
answers.q-joys-treat: A cardamom bun from my own freezer and a candle, even if it is only Tuesday.

answers.q-routine-between: A table in the student union, laptop open, catching up on one club's work between another club's meetings. People stop by constantly, always with a question.
answers.q-routine-sunday: Planning day: meal prep, calendar review, agendas for the week. By evening I've organized seven days and haven't spoken to anyone about anything that isn't a task.
answers.q-belonging-last-laugh: Friday, at the garden. Someone named a very crooked carrot after our treasurer and I laughed properly for the first time all week. I noticed that it was the first time.
answers.q-belonging-almost: A fourth committee. The yes was fully typed. I deleted it, put my phone in my bag, and felt strangely proud.
answers.q-belonging-know-you: That I'm not as on top of things as I look. The color-coded planner is partly a way of not noticing how tired I am.
answers.q-interests-hours: How to get a room of volunteers to actually agree on something. Also, embarrassingly, stationery.
answers.q-interests-making: A handbook for whoever takes over the spring showcase after me. I'm also practicing leaving one evening a week blank, which is harder.
answers.q-values-respect: Showing up when they said they would, without a reminder.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I used to think being needed was the same as being close to people. It isn't, and I learned that slowly.
answers.q-values-time: Unstructured time together. We schedule coffee chats in thirty-minute blocks like dentist appointments.
answers.q-hopes-different: Two free evenings a week, and one person I see regularly with no agenda at all.
answers.q-joys-song: A soft acoustic playlist while I make my list at night. It tricks me into thinking I'm winding down.
answers.q-joys-place: The volunteer garden shed at the end of the day. It smells like soil and nobody can find me there.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Saying no. I expected the workload to be the hard part, and it's actually the sentence "I can't take that on."
answers.q-challenges-easier: Help. I'm very good at offering it and I go oddly quiet when I'm the one who needs it.
answers.q-hopes-learn: How people do nothing well. Some people here can sit on the quad for two hours with no guilt, and I'd like lessons.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The showcase being over, honestly. And the Saturday after it, which I have blocked off and labeled "nothing."
answers.q-challenges-habit: Trying to stop answering messages after 10pm. I've made it three nights out of the last seven.
answers.q-joys-treat: An iced oat latte from the union cafe, sipped slowly, sitting down for once.

answers.q-belonging-know-you: That I'm happy for people and jealous of them simultaneously and it's not one covering for the other, both are fully true, and I wish that were a more acceptable thing to say out loud.
answers.q-interests-hours: Fantasy map design (why do the rivers always split wrong), and honestly also the whole hiring process, which I resent knowing this much about.
answers.q-interests-making: A little website that tracks my applications with colors, which I started so I could call it a project, and now it's the only code I've written for fun in months, so, mixed feelings.
answers.q-values-respect: When someone says where they got rejected from before they say where they got in.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I thought being busy and being on track were the same thing. They are not, I was just busy (it took nine rejections to see the difference).
answers.q-values-time: Being bad at something together. Everyone's hobbies have turned into things you could put on a resume.
answers.q-hopes-different: I'd like to get through a whole conversation with a classmate without mentally ranking us, and also eat lunch somewhere with a window.
answers.q-joys-song: A lo-fi playlist with rain in it, for practice problems, and then one extremely dramatic movie soundtrack for the walk to interviews so I feel like the main character for six minutes.
answers.q-joys-place: The library cafe at 3pm when it empties out, the corner with the wobbly table, I've done basically all my thinking there.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Group projects when everyone in the group is also recruiting, because nobody says they're distracted, we all just quietly do 70 percent.
answers.q-challenges-easier: A practice interview. I know like five people who'd do it and somehow asking feels like admitting I need it (I do).
answers.q-hopes-learn: How to bake bread, from the girl on my floor whose whole hallway smells amazing on Sundays.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: The hackathon, I signed up finally, and I'm trying very hard to treat it like a weekend of building something silly and not like an audition.
answers.q-challenges-habit: Stopping the thing where I look up where people from class ended up. I've got it down to once a day, which I'm told is still a lot.
answers.q-joys-treat: A chocolate croissant from the library cafe if there's one left, eaten slowly, phone face down.

answers.q-values-time: Staying after. The show ends and everyone scatters and the best conversations would've been in the next twenty minutes.
answers.q-hopes-different: A month from now the show's over, so... I'd like there to still be a reason to see people at 7pm. Even one person.
answers.q-joys-song: The overture from our show, in my headphones on the walk over, every single day. I'll be sick of it in a month and I'll miss it in two.
answers.q-joys-place: The costume storage room in the theater basement. It smells like dust and hairspray and nobody can find me there.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Talking in seminar. Give me three hundred people in the dark, FINE. Twelve people around a table looking at me as myself? No thank you.
answers.q-challenges-easier: A plain hangout! With no reason attached! I can ask someone to run lines at midnight but not to get lunch.
answers.q-hopes-learn: How our lighting designer says exactly what she thinks in about six words. I use sixty and still don't get there.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: Opening night!!! And, weirdly, the Monday after closing, just to see who I am that week.

answers.q-joys-treat: Fries from the late window at the dining hall, eaten on the walk home, still in stage makeup.

answers.q-interests-making: A two-person scene with zero jokes in it, for our coach's workshop. Hardest thing I've done all year. I keep trying to sneak in a toaster.
answers.q-values-respect: Makes their scene partner look good and never mentions it.
answers.q-values-changed-mind: I used to think if people were laughing, they liked me. Now I think they like the show, and the me part is a separate audition I keep skipping.
answers.q-values-time: Boring hangouts. Sitting around doing nothing impressive. Highly underrated, zero stars for content, five for everything else.
answers.q-hopes-different: I'd like there to be one person who's seen me on an off day and stuck around. Also I'd like to eat a burrito sitting down.
answers.q-joys-song: The menu music from that puzzle game, on loop, when I'm walking home after shows. It's the audio version of nobody expecting anything from me.
answers.q-joys-place: The black box when it's empty and the ghost light's on. Everyone else thinks it's creepy. It's the one room where I shut up.
answers.q-challenges-harder: Seminar discussions. You'd think the improv guy would crush it, but there's no scene to hide in, it's just my actual opinion sitting there.
answers.q-challenges-easier: To hang out without me being 'on.' I don't know how to request that without it turning into a bit about requesting it.
answers.q-hopes-learn: How to be comfortable in a silence. There's a girl on crew who can just stand next to you saying nothing and it's nice.
answers.q-hopes-looking-forward: Our Friday show, sure, but mostly board game night after. I've been promised I can lose quietly.
answers.q-challenges-habit: Trying to let one joke go by per conversation without saying it. I'm at maybe one in five. It physically hurts.
answers.q-joys-treat: A gas station slushie, blue, the size of my head.
